caption: Books and films use different source keys in one status column.
eval: (async()=>{app.plugins.plugins['bases-checkbox-router'].pro.signOut(); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Checkbox Router/Reading list.base#Routing','',false); let v; for(let i=0;i<100;i++){v=[...app.plugins.plugins['bases-checkbox-router'].views].find(v=>v.root.isConnected&&v.root.offsetParent!==null&&v.config.name==="Routing"); if(v&&v.root.dataset.viewName===v.config.name&&v.root.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length===5)break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} if(!v||v.root.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length!==5)throw Error('Missing sample rows');  return 'Five sample rows';})()
